data: tuning split only (core 70% pool); test sets never touched
search: trial 0 = defaults + 5 seeded random trials per architecture
activation: tuned with ReLU; reused unchanged for GELU
selection: trials within 0.01 macro-F1 of the best: lowest validation loss
a non-default trial must beat the default (trial 0) by >= 0.02 macro-F1, otherwise the default is kept
caveats: selected validation scores are optimistically biased (selection on the same images)
